data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery to500 isn't guaranteed. This assumes those catches; other choices need recalculation. Intentions aren't enforceable. Each: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
